<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check what changed after DOWN
if previous_frame is not None:
    prev_seg = previous_frame.segmentation
    curr_seg = current_frame.segmentation
    
    print("=== Frame diff (after DOWN) ===")
    # Build hash-based comparison
    prev_by_hash = {}
    for n in prev_seg['nodes']:
        prev_by_hash[n['hash']] = n
    curr_by_hash = {}
    for n in curr_seg['nodes']:
        curr_by_hash[n['hash']] = n
    
    all_hashes = set(list(prev_by_hash.keys()) + list(curr_by_hash.keys()))
    changed = False
    for h in all_hashes:
        prev = prev_by_hash.get(h)
        curr = curr_by_hash.get(h)
        if prev and curr:
            if prev['boundary'] != curr['boundary']:
                changed = True
                print(f"  {curr['color']} (hash={h}): {prev['boundary']} -> {curr['boundary']}")
        elif prev and not curr:
            changed = True
            print(f"  DISAPPEARED: {prev['color']}")
        elif not prev and curr:
            changed = True
            print(f"  APPEARED: {curr['color']}")
    
    if not changed:
        print("  No object position changes")

# Check top-right objects now
print("\n=== Top-right objects (after DOWN) ===")
for n in curr_seg['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    if min(rows) <= 12 and min(cols) >= 50:
        print(f"  {n['color']}: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check player position
player = [n for n in curr_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
if player:
    b = player[0]['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"\nPlayer: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
